MSA **SFF-8431** / **SFF-8432**, **10GBASE-ER** / **10GBASE-EW**, **IEEE 802.3ae**, and **0.6–11.3 Gbps** are shared technical data with no per-SKU split, so the same representative pool values are used on each model mode. No penalty objects were supplied.
